standard_prerequisites.name: Infinite sums and rational equivalence of cycles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label remark-infinite-sums-rational-equivalences, invoked at proof line 4554
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies proving the identity for a single integral class and then summing over a locally finite family, which is the first reduction of the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback of the divisor of a meromorphic section along a flat morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-prepare-flat-pullback-cap-c1, invoked at proof line 4576
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the cycle identity h^* div_{L|W}(s) = sum n_i div_{f^*L|W'_i}(s_i) after base change to the preimage of an integral W, which is the whole content of the comparison.

core_obligations: Reduce to a single integral class: write the cycle alpha as a locally finite sum of integral classes, note that by the infinite sums remark it suffices to prove the identity for each component, and reformulate the goal as producing a rational equivalence on the closed subscheme f^{-1}(W) for an integral W of delta-dimension k (proof lines 4546-4556).

Set up the base change: let W' be the preimage of W so that the fibre product square with h : W' -> W and f is available, choose a nonzero meromorphic section s of the restriction of L to W, and write the cycle class of W' as the sum of its components W'_i with multiplicities; since each W'_i dominates W the restrictions s_i are again nonzero meromorphic sections (proof lines 4557-4575).

Conclude: the flat pullback lemma for divisors gives the displayed identity of cycles on W', whose left hand side pushes forward to the flat pullback of c_1(L) cap [W] and whose right hand side pushes forward to c_1(f^*L) cap f^*[W], which is the required equality in the Chow group of X (proof lines 4576-4586).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to one integral class and to a rational equivalence over the preimage of that class (proof lines 4546-4556).
Base change to the preimage, choose a meromorphic section and decompose the preimage into components (proof lines 4557-4575).
Apply the divisor pullback lemma and push the resulting cycle identity to X (proof lines 4576-4586).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projection formula for a first Chern class against flat pullback: f^*(c_1(L) cap alpha) = c_1(f^*L) cap f^*alpha for a flat morphism of relative dimension r (statement lines 4532-4544, tag 02SS). The proof reduces to a single integral class through the infinite sums remark, base changes to the preimage of that class, decomposes the preimage cycle into its components with multiplicities, and then invokes the divisor pullback lemma to obtain the comparison of cycles whose two sides push down to the two sides of the identity. The reduction to the preimage and the pushforward comparison are the substance, so the claim is H2.
